title: Swedish 1970s UFO photographers admitted faking; Sunstrom holds out

tellings.quote: I did so with every single Swedish 1970

plain: A Swedish researcher named Clas Svahn, who has spent decades collecting UFO reports and evidence, says he tracked down every Swedish photographer who took a UFO photo in the 1970s, and that they admitted the pictures were faked. The one exception, he says, is a man named Christ Sunstrom, who still stands by his photo. Svahn tells this as his own investigation, to show how few classic photos survive close checking.
